messages.subject: Re: Render Data Table (SHINY)
parts:
Next time, please produce a copy-pasteable example, that exposes your problem and no other logic in your code (this is called a minimal reproducible example, MRE). That will up the likelihood of getting help here. For your problem, here the MRE:


library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  checkboxInput("data", "Click to select data"),
  uiOutput("panel")
)

server <- function(input,output, session) {
  
  data <- reactive({
    if (input$data) mtcars
    else NULL
  })
  
  output$panel <- renderUI({
    if (is.null(data())) h5("No data")
    else {
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Configuracion", 
          checkboxGroupInput('columnas',"Escoge ...", choices = names(data()))
        ),
        tabPanel("Datos", dataTableOutput("table"))
      )
    }
  })
  
  output$table <- renderDataTable({
    data()
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

And here the correct code:


library(shiny)
library(dplyr)

ui <- fluidPage(
  checkboxInput("data", "Click to select data"),
  uiOutput("panel")
)

server <- function(input,output, session) {
  
  data <- reactive({
    if (input$data) mtcars
    else NULL
  })
  
  output$panel <- renderUI({
    if (is.null(data())) h5("No data")
    else {
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Configuracion", 
          checkboxGroupInput('columnas',"Escoge ...", choices = names(data()))
        ),
        tabPanel("Datos", dataTableOutput("table"))
      )
    }
  })
  
  output$table <- renderDataTable({
    data() %>% select_(.dots = input$columnas)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

Basically, you need to select the columns you want. I.e. just change:

  output$table <- renderDataTable({
    data() 
  })

to: 

  output$table <- renderDataTable({
    data() %>% select_(.dots = input$columnas)
  })

I used dplyr, but you can also use base R.
